claims.text: The hotel sits mid-mountain in Silver Lake Village at Deer Valley Resort, just steps from the chairlifts.

findings.quote: Goldener Hirsch is located at 7520 Royal Street East in Silver Lake Village at Deer Valley Resort, offering a mid-mountain setting just steps from the chairlifts

claims.text: The property was founded in 1992 by the Eccles family of Utah.

findings.quote: The property was founded in 1992 by prominent philanthropic Utah family the Eccles

claims.text: The hotel was inspired by its namesake hotel in St. Moritz, Switzerland.

findings.quote: It was inspired by its namesake hotel in St. Mortiz, Switzerland

claims.text: The hotel offers private ski lockers, a Ski Concierge, ski valet and on-snow storage in Silver Lake Village.

findings.quote: Goldener Hirsch offers private ski lockers, a dedicated Ski Concierge, ski valet and convenient on-snow storage in Silver Lake Village.

claims.text: The hotel offers complimentary transportation within a four-mile radius.

findings.quote: Goldener Hirsch offers complimentary transportation within a four-mile radius of the hotel

claims.text: The Kitz offers outdoor seating on the veranda or in the adjoining Antler Lounge.

findings.quote: Offering additional outdoor seating on the veranda or in the adjoining Antler Lounge, The Kitz

claims.text: The wine list is anchored by Austrian wines, with selections from Jura, Savoie and Alsace.

findings.quote: our list is anchored by Austrian wines, joined by selections from Jura, Savoie and Alsace

claims.text: The Residences are one to three-bedroom homes with private balconies and chef's kitchens.

findings.quote: house one to three-bedroom residences with private balconies, chef’s kitchens, and gracious dining areas

claims.text: The Goldener rooms and suites have original artwork of Austrian landscapes and marble baths with dual vanities and walk-in rain showers.

findings.quote: feature original artwork depicting Austrian landscapes and wood desks that complement the spacious marble baths with dual vanities and walk-in rain showers

claims.text: The residence rental program offers flexible sleeping arrangements, welcome kits for children and babysitting services.

findings.quote: residence rental program that is extremely family-friendly with flexible sleeping arrangements, welcome kits for the kiddos, and babysitting services

claims.text: The hotel combines a Bavarian-inspired inn with modern residences designed by architect Tom Kundig.

findings.quote: blends a charming Bavarian-inspired inn with sleek modern residences designed by award-winning architect Tom Kundig

claims.text: A steel-and-glass tower with the rooftop pool and hot tub connects to the historic inn by a heated bridge.

findings.quote: steel-and-glass, six-story tower adorned with a rooftop heated pool and infinity hot tub that connect (via a heated bridge) to the historic European-style inn

claims.text: The hotel has a heated rooftop pool and an infinity-edge hot tub with views of the Wasatch Mountains, both open to guests year-round.

findings.quote: Goldener Hirsch has a heated rooftop pool and infinity-edge hot tub with views of the surrounding Wasatch Mountains. Both are available to hotel guests year-round

claims.text: Guests can book a half- or full-day ski experience with an Olympic ambassador of Deer Valley.

findings.quote: Enjoy a half- or full-day experience with one of six Olympic ambassadors

claims.text: The Hirsch restaurant has a fireside setting with hand-carved wood details, embroidered velvet furnishings and murals of woodland scenes.

findings.quote: Gather fireside amidst hand-carved wood details, embroidered velvet furnishings and murals of woodland scenes

claims.text: Historic Main Street in Park City is about five minutes away by the hotel's complimentary shuttle.

findings.quote: Historic Main Street is approximately five minutes away and accessible via the hotel’s complimentary shuttle.
